message.content: {"note_claim": "French/UK interception of the Tagor was lawful under UNCLOS right of visit for suspected stateless vessels on the high seas (due to invalid flag), not an act of war.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Under Article 110 of UNCLOS, the reasonable suspicion of statelessness grants warships the Right of Visit. The subsequent verification of irregular documents during the onboard inspection stripped the vessel of its ability to claim flag-state protection", "reason": "The page substantiates that the boarding of the Tagor on the high seas was based on UNCLOS right of visit over suspected statelessness due to a fraudulent flag registration, though it cites Article 110 rather than the note's 165(1)(d) and doesn't mention Madagascar or 'act of war'."}

parsed.note_claim: French/UK interception of the Tagor was lawful under UNCLOS right of visit for suspected stateless vessels on the high seas (due to invalid flag), not an act of war.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Under Article 110 of UNCLOS, the reasonable suspicion of statelessness grants warships the Right of Visit. The subsequent verification of irregular documents during the onboard inspection stripped the vessel of its ability to claim flag-state protection
parsed.reason: The page substantiates that the boarding of the Tagor on the high seas was based on UNCLOS right of visit over suspected statelessness due to a fraudulent flag registration, though it cites Article 110 rather than the note's 165(1)(d) and doesn't mention Madagascar or 'act of war'.
